name: TC-374: any tender in the open body is rejected — a tab is born unpaid
description: The open-check body contract refuses every tender-shaped field with a 400 (payments[], giftCardCode, cashDiscount, processingFee) — the tender is unknown until the guests pay, dual pricing never applies to tabs and the card fee is computed per leg at settlement. DELIVERY orderType is also incompatible with a table.

{"giftCardCode":"AUTOBOGUSCODE"} → An open check cannot carry payments, gift cards, discounts, or fees when it is opened — it is settled when the guests pay.
{"cashDiscount":0.4} → An open check cannot carry payments, gift cards, discounts, or fees when it is opened — it is settled when the guests pay.
{"processingFee":0.5} → An open check cannot carry payments, gift cards, discounts, or fees when it is opened — it is settled when the guests pay.
{"orderType":"DELIVERY"} → An open check is always a dine-in order.
